title: Flock
subtitle: Real-time, Geo-Spatial Social Platform
summary: Architected a full-stack, real-time social platform from scratch featuring real-time presence, geo-spatial query engine, and pub/sub WebSocket replicas.
keyFeatures: Built a Go REST API & dedicated WebSocket server for live presence & RSVP updates with Redis pub/sub for horizontal scaling across replicas.
Designed geo-spatial data layer using PostgreSQL + PostGIS with a quantized-grid Redis caching strategy to keep location queries fast at scale.
Integrated Clerk for authentication, Google Maps Platform API for location search/geocoding, and Meilisearch for full-text search across communities and events.
architectureSummary: Go REST API & WebSocket Server ↔ Redis Pub/Sub Cache ↔ PostgreSQL/PostGIS ↔ Meilisearch Engine

title: AlgoNext
subtitle: In-Browser Code Execution & Online Judge Platform
summary: Full-stack competitive coding platform with sandboxed multi-language code execution and algorithm visualizations.
keyFeatures: Implemented an in-browser code editor using Monaco Editor, integrated with Judge0 for sandboxed multi-language code execution and automated judging.
Designed a Django REST Framework backend with Celery and Redis for async task processing, PostgreSQL (Supabase) for storage, and Node.js for build scripts.
Implemented Clerk for authentication; deployed frontend on Vercel and backend on Render.
architectureSummary: Monaco Editor (Next.js) ↔ Django REST / Celery / Redis ↔ Judge0 Sandbox ↔ Supabase DB

title: RegTech Investigation Workspace
subtitle: AI-Assisted Financial Fraud & KYC Audit System
summary: Synthetic data pipeline and AI reasoning audit trail system for regulator-facing financial fraud investigations.
keyFeatures: Developed a synthetic data pipeline to generate KYC profiles and transaction logs, with detection logic for structuring and rapid fund movement patterns.
Designed an audit trail system that logs each step of the AI's reasoning, supporting human-in-the-loop review and transparency for regulator-facing output.
architectureSummary: Synthetic Data Generator → Fraud Pattern Detection Engine → Streamlit Audit UI → Regulatory Log Output
